name: Maid Youbi wa H ga Ippai
original_name: メイド曜日はＨがいっぱい
source:
Main character saves money to buy the cheapest android maid. But for this price it's a maid with little practical use. Now he needs to spend summer vacations teaching maid basic things - and hopefully get into advanced stuff with time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角存钱买最便宜的机器人女仆。但对于这个价格来说，它是一个几乎没有什么实际用途的女仆。现在，他需要利用暑假教女佣基本知识，并希望随着时间的推移能够掌握高级知识。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
